repo: a document folder for a company moving its order-processing service from a self-managed message broker to a managed one, across three teams: a migration one-pager, team roster, dependency list, the current runbook, an incident summary from the last migration attempt, the change calendar, a vendor limits page. About 25 files.
idea: Cutover requirements a program manager must pin down with the sponsor. Hidden facts could cover: freeze windows, the maximum allowed downtime, rollback trigger and time limit, which team signs off, message ordering guarantees, the data-retention window during dual running, communication deadlines, the date the old broker contract ends.
